storyCards.headline: Head To Toe: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Lisa Lisa And Cult Jam's "Head To Toe" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Head To Toe was released in 1987.

"Head To Toe" by Lisa Lisa And Cult Jam.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
